placements.why: The async decision widget is the product embodiment of the decision-capture-at-consensus thesis. Shipping it (src-1), reporting the velocity that delivered it (src-2), and identifying the Zephyr integration that enabled cross-platform capture (src-3) are all evidence that the narrative is being operationalized as a shipped product. These are position-grain facts (a sprint's delivery accounting) that support the existing thematic leaf rather than naming a new theme.
